title: RayCAD tool holder
description: One tool holder of a library, the file holders/<uuid>.holder.json (PLAN.md 3.6, libraries.h Holder). The shape below the gauge line is a stack of cones and cylinders, listed from the gauge line down; simulation and collision checks use it. Lengths are millimetres. Unknown keys are allowed and are kept when RayCAD saves the holder again.

schema.description: Version of this file's format. A larger value means a newer RayCAD wrote it.

gaugeLength.description: From the gauge line to the face the tool comes out of.

lowerDiameter.description: Diameter at the end nearer the tool.

upperDiameter.description: Diameter at the end nearer the spindle.
